title: Scheduled Walkthroughs and Included Visits under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Each HomeCare program of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty fixes which scheduled walkthroughs it includes, the calendar day after the coverage start date on which each walkthrough window opens, whether one first-year HVAC seasonal check visit is included, and the calendar days after the coverage start date within which the items on the orientation list are completed.

## Entitlements by program

| Program | Sixty-day walkthrough | Eleven-month walkthrough | Twenty-three-month walkthrough | First-year HVAC seasonal check | Orientation list completed within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | Included | Included | Not included | Not included | 30 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | Included | Included | Not included | Not included | 30 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | Included | Included | Not included | Included | 30 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | Included | Included | Included | Included | 21 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | Included | Included | Included | Included | 21 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | Included | Included | Included | Included | 14 |

## Window openings (calendar days after the coverage start date)

| Program | Sixty-day walkthrough may first be held | Eleven-month walkthrough may first be requested | Twenty-three-month walkthrough may first be requested |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 45 | 300 | 670 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 45 | 300 | 670 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 45 | 300 | 670 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 45 | 300 | 670 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 45 | 300 | 670 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 45 | 300 | 670 |

The opening day of the twenty-three-month window is listed for every program, but the walkthrough itself is included only in HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred, HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier and HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve.

## Questions this schedule answers

- *Does a HomeCare 1-2-10 Select home receive an HVAC seasonal check?* No; the check is included from HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus upward.
- *Within how many days are orientation items completed on a HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve home?* Within 14 calendar days after the coverage start date.
